selection: User selected symbols; teacher selected source and complete calendar-year boundaries before downloading research windows, without return-based selection.
source: Yahoo Finance public daily chart JSON; no account or key used; not a guaranteed public API
test_release: W21, after W16 strategy and evaluation protocol freeze; one final historical evaluation; failure must be retained.
prior_exposure: SPY NAV 2024-01-02..08 and some recent issuer rows already viewed; a SPY January 2024 API probe reported only schema and counts. These are outside the 2025 holdout. General historical market knowledge and prior model/user exposure cannot be erased or certified absent.
limits: Research snapshot is a current provider revision, not point-in-time historical availability.
Close is split-adjusted; adj_close also reflects distributions. Neither is an execution quote or NAV.

Adjustment factors may reflect events after a bar or after a partition; do not use absolute adjusted levels as point-in-time features. Later strategy work must specify permitted returns and action handling.
No return calculations, plots, ranking, strategy selection or threshold fitting on final_test before release.
A hash detects changed content, not prior viewing; this is a procedural seal, not encryption or a guarantee of statistical independence.
Market data remains local and ignored by git; metadata, code and source references are reproducible records, not a redistribution license.
